notes: Values are supplied by the primary project authors in processed_data.csv, including author-computed d and p columns; no extractor conversion. Table sample N is preserved under its explicit column name and is not assumed to be analytic n. Narrative success not inferred from coded success columns. Study/sample/test matching requires linked report or paper confirmation. Original paper prints p_rep=.95, not a conventional p-value; conventional p is left null. Text parser renders equality signs as 5. Original blue and red outcomes are distinct. Rescue-locator narrative verdict belongs to the later rescue sample, not the table birch2007_1 sample. Its statistics have not been merged with the historical table sample.
